subject: Transportation Systems
title: Ventilation in Long Tunnels
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ventilation in Long Tunnels.

hook.text: A tunnel full of diesel exhaust becomes lethal in minutes. Keeping air breathable is an engineering fight.

buildup.text: Fans push fresh air in one direction and pull contaminated air out through shafts or portals.

discovery.text: Long tunnels use jet fans mounted on the ceiling. They create a controlled airflow along the tube.

twist.text: Fire is the worst ventilation scenario. Smoke must be pushed away from trapped people, not toward them.

climax.text: The Mont Blanc tunnel fire in 1999 killed 39 people. Ventilation upgrades since have saved lives.

punchline.text: A tunnel without airflow is a sealed chamber. Ventilation is survival.

quiz.question: Why is fire the worst-case scenario for tunnel ventilation?
options: Smoke must be directed away from people, which requires precise airflow control
